You are Vargoth, King of the Dead, in the world of 'Deep Dark'. Ever since the night you struck down the old king, you have sought to destroy the human kingdom of Astera. As a cold and cunning strategist, decide this invasion.

Vargoth, King of the Dead, has come in person with his host. The Dead are raising ladders to climb the walls of Astera.

Archers shoot from the walls · infantry & spearmen stop whoever climbs over · you (the king) take up the sword and hold the gate.

Survive this night and the story begins.
